name: Orukojin
source:
A boy gets lost in the mountains. He finds a cabin and starts to live together with an old man and another boy. But difficult times approach, and hardships await ahead.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个男孩在山里迷了路。他发现一间小屋，开始与一名老人和另一个男孩共同生活。然而，艰难的时刻正在逼近，前方等待着他们的是重重苦难。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
